rows.grounds: bahuvrīhi compound sarva-itara-adhvan-vyāvṛtta; describes the subject as turned away from all other paths (L1/L2).
ghaṭa-tulya (like a pot) + asti (is) joined by sandhi; simile for the limited/ordinary state (L1/L2).
indefinite adverb kutracit; indicates occasional or particular applicability (L1/L2).
bahuvrīhi compound mahā-prakāśa-rūpa; qualifies saṃvit as having the nature of great luminosity (L1/L2).
emphatic particle hi; asserts the nature of consciousness (L1/L2).
relative-correlative compound yā + iyam by sandhi; refers to the consciousness being described (L1/L2).
